comment: Allowed median growth per benchmark name pattern, over the default --threshold (first match wins). Measured on the bench agent over the five v0.4.0 baseline runs: the multi-threaded physics steps of 100 bodies vary up to 40 % (waking the workers), the physics world creation of 100 bodies up to 90 %, the MCP loopback round trips and the game-over scene load about 25 to 33 %; the flat path queries of 1024² maps switch between two modes about 15 % apart (296 µs or 340 µs on the streets map); the prefab instantiations into a 10000-entity scene are bimodal (nightly 2026-10-21 on the bench agent: 148 µs, 168 µs measured alone, baseline 125 µs; locally x2 outliers one run in three on both v0.4.0 and v0.5.0 code). Calibration of 2026-10-21 on the bench agent (build 39239, 5 rounds): the multi-threaded physics step of 5000 falling bodies varies up to 130 % between rounds, the empty script update of 1000 instances 40 %, the prefab instantiation into an empty scene 25 % and the position get/set script 20 %. Calibration of 2026-10-21 with the lights (build 39286, 5 rounds): the settled multi-threaded step of 100 bodies on two workers varies up to 45 %, the game-over scene load 35 % and the path-queue update of 4000 nodes 20 %. Calibration of 2026-10-22 with the physical lights and the tavern (build 39353, 5 rounds): the 5000-vehicle iso frame and the 1000-entity creation vary up to 25 %, the 1000 sliced buildings and the 32x32 four-layer tilemap 30 %, two voxel meshings 25 %; the voxel meshings keep their earlier baseline (a slowdown of the branch, fixed before this baseline). Bench agent builds 40421 to 40555 (2026-10-27/28): the tavern scene load runs 1.26 to 1.33 ms against a baseline of 1.13 ms. Bench agent builds 40326 to 40636 (2026-10-26/28), same culling source: the brute-force frustum test of 1000 boxes (in L1) runs 12.0, 15.0 to 16.0 or 17.8 us with the placement of its loop in the binary, each run within 1 %, while the 10000 and 100000 cases stay within 2 %.
